newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA DEPO RATES FLAT IN LIGHT VOLUME.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA DEPO RATES FLAT IN LIGHT VOLUME.

text.p: Bulgaria's money market activity was thin on Friday due to low demand for funds as interbank deposit rates stayed flat from Thursday, dealers said.
"Demand is low because banks maintain high lev liquidity through foreign currency sales," said a dealer.

The lev has steadied at 994-995 per mark in the past few days on the local foreign exchange market as foreign currency supply topped demand. The lev has been pegged at 1,000 to the mark under a currency board system since July 1.
Interbank overnight lev depo rates stood at 1.50-1.75 percent annually, flat from Thursday. Spot week lev rates were also unchanged at 2.5-3.0 percent annually.
The average annual interbank deposit rate was 1.80 percent on Thursday, up from 2.26 percent on Wednesday, a central bank official said.
The central bank said on Thursday it will raise its main lev interest rate to 5.59 percent annually from 5.50 percent, effective Monday. -- Dessislava Popova, Sofia Newsroom +359-2 91188
